MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The assorted heat shrink tubing would complement my existing wire connectors by helping insulate connections, and the range of sizes makes it useful for different repairs.",
    "The connector kits and glue fit my past interest in electrical connections and repair adhesives, even though I do not need to buy them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Cutting discs, precisely sized screws, and large-diameter tubing require a matching tool or repair need that I have not indicated.",
    "Hose clamps do not imply that I need a motorized valve, and general repair tape does not imply a use for specialized woodworking tape.",
    "The COVID test does not relate to the repair supplies I am considering here."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop or plumbing supply, although the actual job and fit determine whether I would buy it.",
    "My connector and adhesive purchases seem to have prompted more large kits and bulk packs without a clear reason to replenish them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A supply that complements what I already have is more useful right now than another assortment serving much the same purpose.",
    "Dimensions, tool compatibility, and quantity matter to my choice; a related product is only useful if those details match a real need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my repair interests but miss the difference between a useful complementary supply and a specialized or redundant purchase."
}
